params.message:
Add a start page with worksheets and handover, icons in the menu

The root address shows the last working day's worksheets next to the
handover progress, each with its way in. The Dagrapport moves to
/dagrapport under the same route name; an old /?datum= link redirects
there. Every menu item gets an icon from the worksheet marks' set.
